title: Change global background color to royal beige (#DCCBB5)

requirements.text: In frontend/src/index.css, replace all black background color values (e.g., `#000`, `#000000`, `black`, dark OKLCH background variables) with royal beige `#DCCBB5` so that the body background is beige across the entire application. Do not change any text colors, glow effects, fonts, button styles, borders, layout, shadows, animations, spacing, or card styles.

quotes: Change only the global website background color on all pages from black to a royal beige color similar to #DCCBB5.
Apply this color as the main body background across the entire application.
Only replace the black background with the royal beige color. Keep everything else exactly the same.

acceptanceCriteria: The body/html background color resolves to #DCCBB5 (or visually equivalent royal beige) on all pages: Home, Technical, Non-Technical, Register, Contact, and Admin Dashboard.
No black (#000, #000000, or equivalent) remains as the global body or root background.
Text colors, glow effects, neon styles, font families, button appearances, borders, layout structure, shadows, animations, section spacing, card styles, and all functionality remain unchanged.
The beige background is applied globally via CSS custom properties or the body/root selector in index.css, not per-page.

constraints: Do not modify glow or neon effects.
Do not modify fonts or typography.
Do not modify layout or spacing.
Do not modify shadows or animations.
Do not modify any functionality or logic.
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui (immutable paths).
nonGoals: Changing any per-component or per-section background colors beyond the global body/root background.
Redesigning or restyling any UI elements other than the global background.
Changing dark overlay or circuit pattern components.
